rows.name: Wave Terminal
rows.limitation: Computed CSS application and restoration succeeded; the complete visual/lifecycle acceptance criteria did not. Owned main process required forced termination. Earlier CSS round trip and later read-only previews produced blank crops; a recognizable control remains unverified.

rows.name: MongoDB Compass
rows.control: Start on the initial welcome modal
rows.diagnosis: The plain stock flags failed Compass CLI validation. Using the documented parser option allows normal signed startup and reversible cosmetic CSS. Process ownership uses kernel executable identity and start time because Compass changes its displayed process name.

rows.name: Rancher Desktop
rows.control: Cluster Dashboard button on the initial screen
rows.limitation: CSS and restoration were observed, but the harness recorded an interruption during controlled stop and a bundled limactl process required separate owned-process cleanup. The ordinary launch created about 2.30 GiB of persistent Rancher data outside the temporary profile, and free space fell below 8 GiB during the trial. The harness recorded interrupted during controlled stop. Its main child exited after SIGKILL; a bundled limactl process was separately stopped with SIGTERM after verifying its exact owned-image executable path. Ordinary app startup also spawned bundled rdctl and steve processes; no setup controls were operated. Computed CSS application and restoration succeeded; the complete visual/lifecycle acceptance criteria did not. Owned main process required forced termination.

rows.name: Claude
rows.control: Use incognito ghost-icon button on the new-chat screen
rows.diagnosis: Fixed cosmetic CSS application and restoration were observed through official Developer Mode; separate debugger-listener cleanup is required for acceptance.
rows.limitation: Official Developer Mode required manual setup. Fixed main-process JavaScript performed the cosmetic trial, with fixed read-only renderer appearance checks. General-purpose extension JavaScript is not verified. Each controller trial borrowed an existing app process and profile, removed its stylesheet, and detached rather than terminating the app. The debugger listener was closed separately; see setup/cleanup evidence. The documented Developer Mode remains enabled as persistent setup; full settings rollback is not claimed.
rows.jsStatus: Fixed main-process JS and read-only renderer checks verified; extension JS not verified
